final_claim: For binary 3×3 arrays under deletion of one row and one column, the maximum correcting-code size is 4; there are 514 labeled optima and 46 classes under the stated 16 channel symmetries, with orbit-size distribution 2:1, 4:4, 8:20, 16:21.
